release_notes:
- Windows: Nexus now reads the installed R version correctly when it starts (the check failed on every Windows machine and was silently skipped).
- Citation Chaser is much faster: a library of 30-40 seeds now takes about a minute instead of the best part of an hour.
- Citation Chaser shows a progress window with what it is doing and how far it has got, so it no longer looks frozen. It also starts clean each time instead of reloading old results.
- Every section of the app now has its own colour in the card headers, so it is easier to see where you are.
- Library: the toolbar is grouped and every button has a label; the filter bar is no longer yellow.
- Screening: progress and the screening table are in cards, and the table shows a clear message when no studies are loaded.
- Smaller screens: the top menu folds into a button, nothing hides behind the icons, and Library and Screening fit without scrolling sideways.
- Dark mode: the Nexus logo on Home is readable.
- After an update or a lost connection, Nexus waits for the app to be ready before reloading the page.
- Windows: updating now restarts Nexus properly instead of reopening the old version.
